system.notes:
Black mass of Abyssal shadow with six red eyes and 50-foot-wide bat wings. Second only to the Qlippoth Lords, scourge of demons.

AC 13, HP 59, ATK 4 claw +6 (2d6 + engulf) or 1 entropy ray (far) +4 (5d6), MV near (fly), S +5, D -1, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +5, AL C, LV 12

Engulf. If two or more slams hit a target in same round, it is pulled into qlippoth and transformed into a nyogoth qlippoth in 1d4 rounds. STR 15+ on turn to escape.

Great Evil. Only damaged by cold iron or magical sources.

Horrific Appearance. Mortal creatures looking directly at qlippoth, CON 15+ or 1d4 CHA damage. On success, immune for 24 hours.
